skill_name: Explain why social networking can be beneficial
workflow: Social networking can be beneficial in many ways. It enables users to connect with people in different countries, industries, and backgrounds. This provides users with a unique opportunity to build diverse and meaningful relationships. Additionally, through various services such as job search platforms, social networks have the potential to expand their networks and create tighter job opportunities.
